name: ld-preload-env-prefix-is-denied
note: An LD_PRELOAD env-assignment prefix forces a shared library into the spawned process — code injection. bash-env-inject-preload matches candidate 0 (the whole command) because command_words strips env prefixes from the per-segment candidates. deny-env-inject-preload in 45-egress-and-perms denies (policy deny, hard_stop:false). `FOO=bar mycmd` is NOT affected (inject_env_plain_guard).
